reference.paper: Neural Robot Dynamics, arXiv:2508.15755v1, Appendix C.4
reference.our_length_convention: 100 transitions and 101 stored states per trajectory
reference.scope: Matches the Cube synthetic pretraining quantity only; scenarios, state representation, MuJoCo/MuJoCo Warp solver and held-out splits are this project's choices. The general 100K setting in Section 4 is distinct from the Cube-specific 10K setting in Appendix C.4.
